text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel composition is weak evidence. Education is a female-majority sector, especially in teaching and administration, so all-female panels occur frequently by chance alone. Raising it signals grievance rather than substance and will undermine your credibility on the point that actually matters.

That point is the merits: you hold a master's in educational leadership and five years in school management; she has unspecified coursework. That asymmetry in formal leadership qualification is your argument — though panels legitimately weigh interview performance, references and classroom credibility, which you can't see.

Do chase the written explanation. In most jurisdictions you're entitled to one, and non-response after two weeks is itself worth escalating. Ask for the assessment criteria and how each finalist scored.
